item.title: Capital City football waits out weather before rolling past Belton 45-14 | Jefferson City News-Tribune
item.description: The wait for game time was longer than usual Friday night for Capital City. The Cavaliers' opening Class 5 District 7 contest was scheduled to start at 7 p.m. But for Capital City, which arrived in Belton around 3 p.m., the wait was more than four hours as a weather delay pushed the start back an additional hour to 8:21 p.m. “Luckily, they had a smart TV setup, and we just put highlights up, and things of that nature,” Capital City coach Joe Collier said after the Cavaliers posted a 45-14 win against the Belton Pirates to start the postseason. “Just kept their mind focused on a positive feel about football.”

item.title: Fatima softball beats top-ranked Marceline to take third place in Class 2 | Jefferson City News-Tribune

item.title: Southern Boone softball finishes fourth in Class 3 Final Four | Jefferson City News-Tribune
